workspace_note: Measured, not assumed. scripts/evaluate_arm_ik.py solved 729/729 grid positions inside this box with Isaac Sim's Lula solver and the panda_hand frame, all within the manifest's joint limits. The wider box 0.25-0.65 x -0.40-0.40 x 0.10-0.70 reached only 94.4%: every failure sat on the z=0.70 top face or the x=0.65 far face, which is the Panda's reach limit rather than a solver defect. Evidence is under /root/autodl-tmp/embodied/artifacts/ik_eval/.
workspace_frame_note: This box is expressed in the arm base frame and differs from the CPU prototype's box in cpu_prototype_v0.1.json, whose z range of 0.75-1.50 assumed a table-mounted human wrist rather than the Panda's own base.

hand_mapping.span_note: Assumed working ranges of a human hand, not measured per subject: a finger joint bends from straight to roughly a right angle, and abduction stays within about 30 degrees of the palm forward axis. Both ends clamp, so an unusual hand saturates instead of commanding an out-of-limit joint.
